correctness.rationale: One can remove a spanning-tree leaf from a connected cactus and retain a connected cactus. Consequently exhaustive nonempty neighbour-set augmentation of one representative per previous isomorphism class is complete. A fresh implementation used biconnected edge blocks (bridges or cycles), exact adjacency bijections including forced vertex images, and synchronous old-colour/multiset signatures. It obtained 1,1,2,4,9,23,63,188 isomorphism types and failure counts 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,2, with both asserted shapes, stable cell sizes 2,6 and orbit sizes 2,2,4. In both failures every degree-two vertex has one neighbour of each degree, conferring equitable degree cells; the path interiors or the two remaining square vertices cannot be interchanged with the triangle-only vertices by an automorphism.
residual_risks: The replay and proof cover only uniform refinement of connected simple cacti through order eight.
